entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We started off with a huge[n]announcement this time, after all!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I can't wait for the results.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But all that popularity[n]doesn't matter anymore.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right. Things like approval[n]ratings aren't important now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We definitely did the right[n]thing for society.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We just gotta be proud[n]about it, am I right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know, I know.[n]Don't worry about me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: All that's left is to wait[n]calmly for the results.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We should act as normal as we can while[n]we're waiting too.
